verdict.rationale: Ollama's docs assert local-first privacy ('never tracked or trained on', 'nothing you run locally ever leaves your machine'), which implicitly gives users control since data stays on their own machine, but there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, deletion mechanisms, or how data is handled/deleted when using Ollama Cloud. Missing for 10: explicit retention/deletion policy docs, cloud data handling and deletion controls, any audit or settings UI for managing stored data.
